# GSE Integrated
> Licensed electrical contractor serving the greater Baton Rouge, LA area since 2009.

## Services
- Residential and commercial electrical services
- Alarm and security system installation and monitoring
- Standby generator installation and maintenance (authorized Generac dealer)
- New construction electrical (pre-electrical, rough-in, trim-out)
- EV charging station installation (certified Tesla partner)
